_comment: Grant voucher (RFC-AITP-0005 §8). Minted by the TCT issuer alongside the TCT and delivered in the same MUTUAL_COMMIT / MUTUAL_COMMIT_ACK payload; it is what lets the subject later delegate (RFC-AITP-0006) without anyone reconstructing TCT bytes. On the wire it is an opaque compact JWS (typ 'aitp-grant+jwt'). The token below is a PLACEHOLDER: the header segment is real base64url of {"alg":"EdDSA","typ":"aitp-grant+jwt"}, but the payload and signature segments are human-readable stand-ins and will fail cryptographic verification. _decoded_claims shows what the payload segment would decode to: iss/sub/grants/iat/exp equal the companion TCT's values, and src_jti is the companion TCT's jti (the revocation linkage). This voucher is the one embedded verbatim in examples/delegation/single-hop.json. For a real, verifiable voucher see schemas/conformance/known-answer/signed-examples/grant-voucher/.
